detail.longDescription: I'm trying to test a REST client API generated with OpenAPI generator. The src folder content is generated by OpenAPI generator, I shouldn't edit it as it can be re-generated. ├── src │ ├── apis │ │ ├── configuration.rs │ │ ├── events_notification_api.rs │ │ ├── events_subscription_api.rs │ │ ├── mod.rs │ │ ├── service_api.rs │ │ └── service_instance_api.rs │ ├── lib.rs │ └── models │ └── [...] │ ├── debug │ │ ├── [...] └── tests └── tests.rs The lib.rs has this content: #![allow(unused_imports)] #![allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] extern crate serde_repr; extern crate serde; extern crate serde_json; extern crate url; extern crate reqwest; pub mod apis; pub mod models; and the configuration.rs this one: #[derive(Debug, Clone)] pub struct Configuration { pub base_path: String, pub user_agent: Option<String>, pub client: reqwest::Client, pub basic_auth: Option<BasicAuth>, pub oauth_access_token: Option<String>, pub bearer_access_token: Option<String>, pub api_key: Option<ApiKey>, } pub type BasicAuth = (String, Option<String>); #[derive(Debug, Clone)] pub struct ApiKey { pub prefix: Option<String>, pub key: String, } impl Configuration { pub fn new() -> Configuration { Configuration::default() } } impl Default for Configuration { fn default() -> Self { Configuration { base_path: "https://our.host:443/context/serviceInventoryManagement/v5.0".to_owned(), user_agent: Some("OpenAPI-Generator/5.0.0/rust".to_owned()), client: reqwest::Client::new(), basic_auth: None, oauth_access_token: None, bearer_access_token: None, api_key: None, } } } Instead of adding tests to lib.rs that can be overwritten, I've chosen to create a tests folder, where I've put a test.rs file, I can run with a cargo test as soon as I've started the REST server part, aside. But I'm failing to access my Configuration structure to create an instance of it. mod test { use configuration::Configuration; /** */ #[test] fn dummy() { // list_service(configuration: &configuration::Configuration, filter: Option<std::collections::HashMap<String, String>>, default_filter: Option<bool>, all_providers: Option<bool>) } /** Returns a generic configuration to join the default REST server */ fn genericConfiguration() { let mut cfg = Configuration::new; } } I'm receiving a compilation error at cargo test : tests/tests.rs:2:9 | 2 | use configuration::Configuration; | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^ use of unresolved module or unlinked crate `configuration` How to declare my use directive correctly?
